description_excerpt: Job Description • Receive and review of Inspection orders, SOP’s and instruction before conducting inspection. • Perform inspection in a professional manner, ensuring that inspections are carried out in accordance with Inspection Order, SOP’s and client’s instruction and as per Division Quality Procedures. • Keep related Manager/Supervisor informed on daily basis or as required as to the progress of the inspections and report any problems identified when performing an inspection. • Prepare accurate and detailed field inspection reports. • Preparation of samples as required by division…
